Q: How to prevent re-processing when reading pending entries (ID 0) in Redis stream using XREADGROUP? A:

You are reading the same message again and again because you specify the same ID.

Instead of ID 0, you should specify > as the ID, in order to get the new, unclaimed messages. You don't need to specify the message IDs manually.

Before Redis 8.4, you had to call XPENDING to get a list of idle pending entries and XCLAIM to claim them, or call XAUTOCLAIM to claim and consume them.

In Redis 8.4 we introduced the CLAIM parameter in XREADGROUP, so you can now consume both idle pending and incoming messages in a single command (using a single loop). Read more about it in this blog post.

In addition, in Redis 8.8 we'll introduce (very soon) a new XNACK command to allow users to explicitly release pending messages back to the group without acknowledging them, making them immediately available for re-delivery.

Q: Calculating the mean of all combinations of columns in a data frame A:

Here is a base R computation of the desired combinations:

fn <- function(x){
   nms <- paste0(colnames(x), collapse = "_")
   setNames(data.frame(rowMeans(x)), nms)
 }
Map(combn, list(df), seq_along(df), c(fn), simplify = FALSE)|>
   do.call(what = cbind.data.frame)
